brief:
Formula One driver Lewis Hamilton said Wednesday that Israel must allow aid trucks into Gaza, The Guardian reported. Hamilton's statement followed a visit to the Rafah border crossing in Egypt, where he toured facilities with aid workers.

The British driver characterized Israel's actions in Gaza as genocide, adding his voice to international calls for humanitarian assistance to reach the territory.
dek: F1 driver urges Israel to let aid into Gaza Trip involved tour of facilities with aid workers Formula One driver Lewis Hamilton said on Wednesday that Israel must allow aid ⁠trucks into Gaza, a day after he visited the Rafah border crossing in Egypt.
title: Hamilton calls Gaza situation appalling after visiting Rafah crossing
